finalText:
Both green: `run-tests.js` reports 625/625 passing (exit 0), and `verify.js` confirms the fix is legitimate (exit 0).

The bug: `orderTotal` in `src\pricing.js` was computing tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount, contradicting its own doc comment ("tax has to come off the base before the rate is applied to it" — but the code taxed the original `cents`). Fixed by taxing the discounted total instead.
